milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining magenta wool by hand (or any tool) drops the magenta_wool item into the player's inventory. The player starts with zero magenta_wool, so detecting ≥1 confirms the block was successfully mined. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.

Uses inventory_has because crafting 9 lapis_lazuli into a lapis_block at the crafting table places the lapis_block into the player's inventory. The player starts with zero lapis_blocks, so detecting ≥1 confirms the crafting was completed. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks.
